name: PvZ 95 Edition
description: The 95 Edition (95版), the hard-mode remix of Plants vs Zombies, as a mod: the rebalance its author patched into PlantsVsZombies.exe, ported rule by rule from a byte-level diff of the remix's patched executable against the retail one. The remix's loose art files are only the Chinese localisation of the retail art, so the mod contributes no resources at all and everything is read from the retail main.pak.
